name: OS Toolkit
description: Schedule the Windows light and dark theme. Windows has no custom day/night schedule, so ND owns the times and applies them either directly or through PowerToys Light Switch when you already use it. Reads are free; changing your theme always asks first when an agent calls it.

settings.title: Run the day/night schedule
settings.description: Off by default. Nothing changes your theme until you turn this on.

settings.title: Apply backend
settings.description: auto, native, or powertoys. auto uses PowerToys Light Switch when it is installed and enabled, otherwise ND writes the Windows theme directly.

settings.title: Dark theme starts at
settings.description: 24-hour HH:MM. Must differ from the light start.

settings.title: Apply to apps
settings.description: Writes AppsUseLightTheme. Only affects apps that honor the Windows theme.

settings.title: Apply to the taskbar and system
Turn off Light Switch's own schedule
settings.description: Used with the PowerToys backend only, so the two schedulers cannot fight over the same setting.

settings.title: Apply the correct theme when ND starts
settings.description: Also re-checks after the computer wakes, so a switch missed while ND was closed self-heals.

commands.title: Light theme now
commands.description: Switch Windows to the light theme immediately.

commands.title: Dark theme now
commands.description: Switch Windows to the dark theme immediately.

commands.title: Toggle the Windows theme
commands.description: Flip Windows between light and dark.

views.title: OS Toolkit
views.description: The schedule only runs while ND is open.

actions.title: Read the current theme and schedule state
Probe which theme backends are available
